title: Networking Executive – Insurance
description:
**Job Summary**

The Networking Executive – Insurance will be responsible for building, developing, and maintaining strong relationships with hospitals, healthcare providers, insurance companies, and Third\-Party Administrators (TPAs). The role involves hospital empanelment, provider onboarding, documentation, coordination, relationship management, issue resolution, and network expansion to support smooth insurance operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Provider Network Management**

* Develop and maintain professional relationships with hospitals, clinics, insurance companies, and TPAs.
* Identify potential hospitals and healthcare providers for network expansion.
* Coordinate the onboarding and empanelment of new healthcare providers.
* Maintain an updated database of hospitals, insurers, TPAs, and provider contacts.
* Ensure provider details, agreements, and contact information are accurate and updated.

**2\. Hospital Empanelment \& Credentialing**

* Coordinate hospital empanelment with insurance companies and TPAs.
* Collect and verify required hospital and provider documents.
* Follow up with hospitals, insurers, and TPAs regarding empanelment applications.
* Track empanelment status and ensure timely completion of documentation.
* Support renewal, re\-credentialing, and agreement renewal processes.

**3\. Relationship Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned hospitals and insurance partners.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups and meetings with network partners.
* Understand and address concerns raised by hospitals, insurers, and TPAs.
* Maintain strong and professional relationships with key stakeholders.
* Ensure timely communication and effective partner support.

**4\. Coordination \& Issue Resolution**

* Coordinate with internal teams such as Insurance Operations, Claims, Billing, Accounts, and Management.
* Facilitate communication between hospitals, insurance companies, and TPAs.
* Assist in resolving operational and documentation\-related issues.
* Follow up on pending cases, approvals, agreements, and service\-related concerns.
* Support smooth implementation of insurance processes and network initiatives.

**5\. Documentation \& Compliance**

* Maintain proper records of empanelment documents, agreements, renewals, and correspondence.
* Ensure documentation is complete, accurate, and properly maintained.
* Support internal and external audits by providing required documents and reports.
* Follow organizational policies, procedures, and applicable healthcare insurance requirements.

**6\. Reporting \& MIS**

* Prepare regular MIS reports related to hospital empanelment and network activities.
* Track new provider additions, renewals, pending applications, and partner issues.
* Maintain accurate records of network performance and activities.
* Provide regular updates to the reporting manager.

**7\. Business Development \& Network Expansion**

* Identify potential hospitals and healthcare providers for network expansion.
* Conduct hospital visits and meetings as required.
* Assist in developing new provider partnerships.
* Support management in partnership discussions and negotiations.
* Explore opportunities to strengthen the organization's healthcare provider network.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in **Hospital Administration, Healthcare Management, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field**.
* MBA/MHA or relevant postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* **2–5 years of experience** in hospital networking, insurance operations, hospital empanelment, TPA coordination, healthcare relationship management, or business development.
* Experience working with hospitals, insurance companies, or TPAs is preferred.

**Required Skills**

* Good understanding of **health insurance and TPA operations**.
* Knowledge of hospital empanelment and provider networking.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good negotiation and relationship\-management abilities.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* Good knowledge of MS Office, Excel, email, and CRM/HIS systems.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and meet deadlines.
* Willingness to travel for hospital visits and partner meetings when required.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Number of new hospitals/providers successfully empanelled.
* Empanelment completion and turnaround time.
* Network expansion and provider coverage.
* Contract and renewal completion rate.
* Timely resolution of partner\-related issues.
* Accuracy and completeness of provider documentation.
* Partner relationship and engagement effectiveness.
* Timeliness and accuracy of MIS reports.
* Compliance with organizational processes and requirements.

**Job Requirements**

* Strong professional communication and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to build long\-term relationships with hospitals and insurance stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
* Willingness to travel within the assigned territory.
* Target\-oriented and organized approach to work.

Work Location: In person

title: ORACLE APPS DBA
description:
Experience

3\+ years of relevant experience in Oracle Applications Database Administration.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Oracle Apps DBA with 3\+ years of experience in implementing, administering, maintaining, upgrading, and troubleshooting Oracle E\-Business Suite (EBS) environments. The candidate should have hands\-on experience with EBS R12\.1\.3 and R12\.2\.x, Oracle Database administration, RAC environments, application cloning, online patching, Disaster Recovery (DR), and performance tuning.

1\. Oracle EBS Administration

· Install, configure, administer, and maintain Oracle E\-Business Suite R12\.1\.3 and R12\.2\.x environments.

· Manage EBS application and database tiers across development, testing, UAT, and production environments.

· Perform routine application administration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

· Manage Forms, OAF, WebLogic, Apache/OHS, and Concurrent Processing services.

· Manage users, responsibilities, profile options, and application security.

2\. Cloning and Environment Management

· Perform EBS application\-tier and database\-tier cloning activities.

· Execute production\-to\-test and production\-to\-development refreshes.

3\. Patching and Maintenance

· Perform EBS patching using ADOP and AD Administration utilities.

· Apply AD, TXK, application, database, Forms, Reports, WebLogic, and technology\-stack patches as required.

· Perform OPatch activities, investigate patch conflicts, and monitor patch logs.

· Apply critical security patches and maintain environments according to approved maintenance plans.

4\. Oracle EBS Upgrade

· Participate in EBS upgrades, including upgrades from R12\.1\.3 to R12\.2\.x.

· Coordinate with functional, development, infrastructure, and application teams.

· Troubleshoot technical issues encountered during upgrade and migration activities.

5\. Oracle Database Administration

· Administer Oracle databases, including Oracle 11g, 12c,19c and 26AI.

· Monitor database availability, tablespaces, datafiles, archive logs, and space utilization.

· Perform database startup, shutdown, and routine maintenance activities.

· Monitor database alerts, logs, and performance\-related issues.

· Manage database users, privileges, invalid objects, and basic performance troubleshooting.

· Support backup and recovery activities using RMAN and established recovery procedures.

6\. Oracle RAC Administration

· Support Oracle Real Application Clusters (RAC) environments hosting Oracle EBS databases.

· Monitor RAC database instances, services, and cluster availability.

· Perform basic RAC administration and troubleshooting using srvctl, crsctl, and SQL\*Plus, as applicable.

· Troubleshoot RAC instance, service, listener, and connectivity issues.

· Coordinate with infrastructure and storage teams to investigate cluster, network, and shared\-storage issues.

· Support planned RAC maintenance and understand load balancing, failover, and high\-availability concepts.

7\. Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity

· Support implementation, maintenance, and validation of Oracle EBS Disaster Recovery environments.

· Participate in DR planning, DR drills, and failover/failback activities.

· Support database DR configurations using Oracle Data Guard, where applicable.

· Monitor Data Guard synchronization, redo transport, and apply status.

· Assist in validating database and application\-tier readiness at the DR site.

· Coordinate with infrastructure, network, storage, and application teams during DR testing and recovery.

· Maintain DR runbooks, recovery procedures, validation checklists, and implementation documentation.

· Understand RTO and RPO requirements and support activities aligned with approved DR procedures.

8\. Middleware and Security Integration

· Administer and troubleshoot Oracle Fusion Middleware components used by EBS.

· Support WebLogic, Forms, Reports, OHS, and related application services.

· Support integration with Oracle Internet Directory (OID), Oracle Access Manager (OAM), and Single Sign\-On (SSO).

· Troubleshoot authentication, login, Forms launch, and middleware connectivity issues.

· Perform configuration and validation activities following middleware patching or maintenance.

9\. Concurrent Processing and Application Support

· Monitor and troubleshoot concurrent managers, concurrent requests, and request sets.

· Investigate pending, running, warning, and error requests.

· Troubleshoot manager startup failures and long\-running requests.

· Support migration and deployment of RDF, RTF, FMB, and XML files.

· Coordinate with functional and development teams to resolve application issues.

10\. Production Support and Documentation

· Provide L2/L3 technical support for Oracle EBS production environments.

· Participate in planned maintenance, month\-end activities, patching, cloning, upgrades, and DR exercises.

· Perform root\-cause analysis and document incident resolutions.

· Follow change management, incident management, and escalation procedures.

· Prepare technical documentation, implementation and rollback plans, DR runbooks, and status reports.

· Coordinate with customers and cross\-functional teams to ensure timely issue resolution.

Required Technical Skills

**Oracle Applications**

**Oracle EBS R12\.1\.3 and R12\.2\.x**

**EBS Administration**

ADADMIN, ADOP, AutoConfig, context files, cloning

**Patching**

AD/TXK patches, application patches, OPatch, technology\-stack patching

**Database**

Oracle 11g, 12c, and 19c; database administration

**Oracle RAC**

RAC architecture, instance and service monitoring, basic RAC troubleshooting

**Disaster Recovery**

DR concepts, DR drills, failover/failback support, Data Guard fundamentals

**Backup and Recovery**

RMAN backup and recovery fundamentals

**Middleware**

WebLogic, Forms, Reports, OHS, Fusion Middleware

**Security**

OID, OAM, SSO integration and troubleshooting

**Concurrent Processing**

Concurrent managers, requests, and request sets

**Operating Systems**

Linux/Unix; Windows exposure,IBM AIX

**Troubleshooting**

EBS login, Forms, concurrent processing, patching, cloning, connectivity, RAC, and DR issues

**Documentation**

Technical procedures, RCA, change records, DR runbooks, and status reports

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience supporting development, test, UAT, and production EBS environments.

· Hands\-on experience with EBS upgrades and online patching.

· Experience supporting Oracle RAC databases and high\-availability configurations.

· Exposure to Oracle Data Guard and database DR exercises.

· Experience working with customers in a production\-support environment.

· Knowledge of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) or other cloud\-hosted EBS environments.

· Oracle EBS or Oracle Database certifications are an advantage.

Key Competencies

· Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.

· Ability to work independently during planned maintenance and production incidents.

· Good communication and customer\-handling skills.

· Ability to coordinate with functional, development, infrastructure, network, and database teams.

Strong documentation, ownership, and problem\-solving abilities

Work Location: In person

title: Database Administrator
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

● Install, configure, maintain, and upgrade database systems.

● Monitor database performance, availability, capacity, and overall system health.

● Proactively identify potential database performance issues, bottlenecks, and risks, and clearly communicate findings to System Administrators and/or software vendors when resolution requires action from the respective parties.

● Manage database users, roles, permissions, and access controls.

● Perform regular database backups and ensure disaster recovery readiness.

● Maintain database security, integrity, and confidentiality.

● Troubleshoot database issues and minimize system downtime.

● Optimize SQL queries and overall database performance.

● Support application teams with database\-related requirements and troubleshooting.

● Maintain accurate database documentation, configuration details, and change records.

● Ensure compliance with company IT and security policies.

**Key Requirements**

● Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field with 4\+ year experience .

● Experience with SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar database management systems.

● Prior experience in administering databases with large transactional volumes and high\-

volume database environments.

● Strong knowledge of SQL, database backup and recovery, security, and performance tuning.

● Good troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.

● Ability to identify database performance bottlenecks and coordinate effectively with

System Administrators, application teams, and software vendors.

● Knowledge of high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) solutions is preferred.

Pay: ₹45,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund
